proposed_comments.title: Wait for queued requests before shutdown
proposed_comments.body:
### Wait for queued requests before shutdown

**Severity:** `high`

When stdin reaches EOF, finalization starts immediately even if previously received requests are still running in the serialized request chain. That can dispose the provider and tear down the protocol bridge before those requests finish, dropping responses or notifications. Wait for the queue to settle before finalizing so EOF shutdown preserves the ordering guarantees of the request pipeline.

```suggestion
    void chain.then(() => finalize(0));
```

proposed_comments.title: Reserve generated form identifiers

review.body: The refreshed TypeScript SDK head still has request-shutdown ordering and form-ID collision issues that can drop responses or route submissions to the wrong handler.

judgment.rationale: The current head finalizes immediately at EOF despite a serialized request queue, and its generated form identifiers do not reserve explicit IDs. Both failures were fixed and validated on the resumed fork review.
evidence: The EOF handler invokes asynchronous finalization without awaiting the existing request chain.
The form collector overwrites map entries when an explicit ID collides with a generated form-N identifier.
